CANDIDATE READY — bd-01M16BFTZNPEP1VAXDGWDBTE4G, exact SHA 0a65e79b6fc2ef32f9292fbe0ddfcbcd28fd3e4c (parent 7340bc7). I have not landed or pushed it.

WHAT CLOSES: all ten assigned embed-core values are final non-case classes: RemoteCapability, AuthorizedRemoteRequest, ValidatedVector, EmbeddingReceipt, ItemDigest, SensitiveDigest, CacheKey, EmbeddingSpace, GeometryPair, EmbedBatch. Public read access is unchanged. Each has explicit structural equals/hashCode and an intentional concise toString; payload/vector/digest material is omitted or redacted. All smart/policy construction sites now call private constructors directly. EmbeddingSpace's former provisional.copy identity step is a two-stage private construction.

PRE-FIX EXECUTABLE PROOFS:
- privacy boundary on untouched main 8b09ac77: RemotePolicy.evaluate returned Left(Denied(..., provider not allowed)); RemoteCapability.fromProduct nevertheless minted the denied provider with expiry 0 < now 1000, and AuthorizedRemoteRequest.fromProduct packaged the same detector-certified payload. Runtime flags capabilityOffAllowlist=true, expired=true, payloadBound=true.
- arithmetic boundary before any initial production edit: ValidatedVector.fromProduct minted dimension=2 / length=1 / NaN / norm=NaN while ValidatedVector.of on the identical tuple returned Left(DimensionMismatch(2,1)).

SHAPE TEST: ten separately named external fromProduct refusals, one per type, plus a positive public-read control over every field. Per the bead, I did not add copy/unapply/Product assertions; the two old RemoteCapability/Authorized copy probes and the old GeometryPair copy probe were removed rather than carried forward.

CAPACITY MUTATION after embedCoreJVM/clean: temporarily restore all ten classes to case classes. Production and tests compiled; ConstructionProbeSuite then failed exactly the ten named fromProduct tests, 10 failed / 23, 13 passed, Errors 0. Reverted source and cleanly rebuilt: embedCoreJVM 137/137.

REFERENCE SCOPE recomputed from every */src/main Scala hit: embed-core, embed-bench, embed-grakern, exactly the bead's list.

EXACT COMMITTED-SHA GATE: ordinary clean local clone detached at 0a65e79, no worktree shim. One unpiped sbt process redirected to exact-gate.log; command's own SBT_EXIT=0:
scalafmtCheckAll; scalafmtSbtCheck; compileAll; embedCoreJVM/test; embedCoreJS/test; embedCoreNative/test; embedBench/test; embedGrakern/test.
Counts: embed-core 137/137 on JVM, JS, Native; embed-bench 50/50; embed-grakern 25/25. Zero test failures/errors. One external Scala Native warning reports deprecated clang 15.0.0; no source/compiler warning.

Main is now 8250924; diff from parent through current main has zero changes in any of my 13 touched paths, so I did not re-cut under the churn ruling. Please independently review and ACK/BLOCK merge.
